name: Keychron K8 Pro
description: The Keychron K8 Pro is a hot-swappable TKL mechanical keyboard supporting both QMK/VIA customization and dual-mode Bluetooth 5.1 or wired connectivity. Its south-facing RGB backlight and gasket-mounted plate deliver a comfortable typing feel suited to both office work and casual gaming.

name: Logitech MX Keys
description: The Logitech MX Keys is a low-profile wireless keyboard with scissor-switch keys engineered for a stable, quiet, and precise typing feel. Smart illumination and multi-device Easy-Switch pairing make it a go-to choice for professionals working across several computers.

name: Razer Huntsman V3 Pro
description: The Razer Huntsman V3 Pro uses analog optical switches with adjustable actuation points down to 0.1mm, giving competitive players granular control over sensitivity. Its aluminum top plate and per-key RGB lighting combine premium build quality with elite-tier responsiveness.

name: Corsair K70 RGB Pro
description: The Corsair K70 RGB Pro pairs a durable aluminum frame with hot-swappable Corsair mechanical switches and per-key RGB lighting powered by iCUE. Its 8,000Hz polling rate and dedicated media controls make it a well-rounded pick for gamers who also value build quality.

name: ASUS ROG Azoth
description: The ASUS ROG Azoth is a premium 75% gasket-mounted keyboard with triple-layer sound dampening foam, hot-swappable switches, and a small OLED display for quick settings access. Wireless 2.4GHz, Bluetooth, and wired modes give it enthusiast-grade flexibility in a compact form factor.

name: HyperX Alloy Origins Core
description: The HyperX Alloy Origins Core features a full aluminum body with HyperX-designed mechanical switches rated for 80 million keystrokes. Its compact TKL layout and per-key RGB lighting make it a durable, space-saving option for gaming desks.

name: SteelSeries Apex Pro TKL
description: The SteelSeries Apex Pro TKL uses adjustable OmniPoint 2.0 magnetic switches, letting each key's actuation point be tuned individually via software. A precision OLED smart display and aircraft-grade aluminum frame round out a keyboard built for performance-focused gamers.

name: Ducky One 3 Daybreak
description: The Ducky One 3 Daybreak brings a vibrant two-tone colorway to a double-shot PBT keycap set paired with Cherry MX switches for reliable, satisfying feedback. Its hot-swappable PCB and per-key RGB lighting make it a popular canvas for enthusiast customization.

name: Royal Kludge RK84
description: The Royal Kludge RK84 is a budget-friendly 75% hot-swappable keyboard offering tri-mode connectivity across Bluetooth, 2.4GHz wireless, and wired USB-C. Its compact layout and RGB backlighting make it an accessible entry point for switching to mechanical keyboards.

name: NuPhy Air75 V2
description: The NuPhy Air75 V2 is an ultra-slim low-profile mechanical keyboard combining a machined aluminum frame with NuPhy's low-profile switches for a fast, quiet typing feel. Tri-mode wireless connectivity and a portable design make it ideal for minimalist, travel-friendly setups.
